text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring). One of the 
pinnacle GⅠ races that the Mejiro family 
holds as their ultimate goal. And then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as promised, Mejiro Bright must claim 
"victory" in this race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please do not make such a scary 
face~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am quite alright. As promised, I shall 
win without fail and claim the Shield that 
protects Mejiro—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Bright, you understand, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A new era that emphasizes speed. Before 
making our mark there, we must first 
demonstrate strength worthy of 
representing the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Let's show solid results in this glorious 
long-distance GⅠ before moving on to 
medium distance. Understood?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I will without fail run just like Lady 
McQueen did "back then."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, if you manage to win the Tenno Sho 
(Spring)... it would be the first victory 
since my own—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you can win, you are a worthy 
successor. First, come stand beside me.
